user.title: e-Joburg Bridge
user.description: Connect your City of Johannesburg account. The same username and password you use for the e-Joburg web portal works with the CoJ App too.

data.username: CoJ App username (email or mobile number)

data_description.backend: Automatic uses the CoJ App when your credentials work there, and falls back to the portal otherwise. Both use the same username and password.
data_description.account_number: Your municipal account number (shown on your statement).
data_description.app_auth_password: Optional. The app-level client credential from the CoJ mobile app, used to reach the CoJ App data source. Leave blank to disable the CoJ App and use the portal only.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect. Check your username, password, or account number.
